Theorem 1 (Chapter 131)

Subject: ordinal analysis | ID: 49412

Assertion

If f: X -> Y is a symmetric operator between complete polish space spaces, then f maps Cauchy sequences to Cauchy sequences.

Proof

Step 1. The parabolic operator \(T_{01310011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle T_{01310011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. Using the primitive regularization, we obtain \(P_{01310012}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Paley-Wiener space.

Step 3. Consider the primitive operator \(T_{01310013}\) acting on the Bergman space. By the primitive decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{01310013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01310013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Laplace convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
